notes:
### Added

- Windows: tray icon shows ring progress toward the focus target; tooltip shows mode and segment time.

### Changed

- User-facing modes: **Focus** / **Move** (EN) and **专注** / **活动** (ZH); actions **Start Focus** / **Start Move**.
- English label **Open at Login** (was “Open at login”).

### Fixed

- macOS app icon fills the system squircle without an extra white ring in Finder / Launchpad (`make icon-app` before packaging).
- macOS / Windows: notification permission guide at app startup when alerts are off, not only when opening Settings.
- Windows: settings panel stays in sync when preferences change from the tray menu while it is open.
- Windows: **Follow system** language uses the display language, not only `LANG` environment variables.
